# Release Queue

![Release Queue function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/synchronization/queue/05_Release%20queue.svg)

[Synchronization functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Releases this obtained access, preserving independently obtained accesses unless force destroy is true. Forced destruction invalidates all accesses and wakes waits with errors. Cleanup also executes with an incoming error. Returns the FIFO snapshot before release and never returns a queue reference. Queue&lt;T&gt; is an execution resource reference; element is the ordinary T value. Public FROG target compilation remains unavailable.

## Queue behavior

Releases this obtained access. Independently obtained accesses remain valid unless force destroy? is true. Forced destruction invalidates all accesses and wakes pending operations with errors. Cleanup runs even with an incoming error. The outputs describe the FIFO before release; this function has no queue-reference output.

Queue&lt;T&gt; is a nominal execution-resource access reference. The complete T schema is invariant; an Array, Cluster or Enum message remains one T value. Collection outputs add one outer rank-1 Array.
